answer: Durable Reputation Phantom.** Each identity accrues a history anchor (call it cedar) tied to its action log; operators who spawn wallets inherit a shared failure signature from their first flagged clone. A plume of cross-referenced behavioral traces links wallets to the same control pattern, and enforcement applies a pearl penalty: the operator's existing identities lose ranking weight and outbound reach. Each new clone costs the attacker one degraded prior identity, so scaling requires sacrificing real accrued value per attempt.
